finding.issue: socket2 0.6.5 direct conversions to std UnixStream and UnixListener require its all feature; a combined build can hide the missing independent-package requirement through feature unification.
finding.original_compile_failure: Owner reports actual unchanged 0e4a cargo check -p broker exit 101; a prior negative-control compile failure is not a semantic negative-control success.
finding.resolution: All three sites now move Socket into OwnedFd and then into the standard Unix socket type. From<Socket> for OwnedFd does not require the all feature. Descriptor ownership transfers exactly once; no dup, raw pointer ownership change, extra syscall, feature addition or protocol change is introduced.

unchanged_boundaries: connect_timeout uses the original absolute deadline
only ConnectionRefused can cause stale-socket unlink
same original socket descriptor underlies the transport or listener fixture
native and negative-control gates must run on the corrected exact source
